name: Frostbound
setting: icy temple courtyard, snow banks, frozen pines, blue glaciers, frost-covered rune pillars
palette: cold slate blue, ice cyan, muted snow white
text: Enemies move 12% slower. Heroes attack 8% slower; shrine tiles restore normal attack speed.

name: Ashen Forge
setting: obsidian forge courtyard, lava channels only along borders, scorched dwarven pillars, ember-lit furnaces
text: Road heroes deal 15% more damage but receive 20% less healing. Platform heroes keep normal healing.

name: Stormpeak
setting: mountaintop storm temple courtyard, broken lightning rods, rain-darkened stone, cloud banks outside edges
palette: slate violet, electric blue, subdued silver
text: Flying enemies move 20% slower. Platform heroes reach one step less; high-ground tiles shelter them.

name: Tidal Ruins
setting: sunken coastal temple courtyard above shallow sea, coral pillars, tide pools and turquoise surf strictly at borders
text: Enemies move 15% slower on odd waves and 10% faster on even waves. Plan your blockers around the tide.

name: Mycelium Hollow
setting: underground mushroom sanctuary courtyard, giant bioluminescent fungi, twisting fungal roots and cave walls only at edges
palette: deep plum, muted turquoise, luminous mint
text: Heroes receive 25% more healing. Enemies gain 10% maximum health.

name: Crystal Vault
setting: ancient crystal cavern temple courtyard, amethyst and aquamarine formations, fractured rune obelisks only at edges
text: Magical heroes deal 15% more damage. Physical heroes gain 10% attack speed.

name: Haunted Necropolis
setting: abandoned necropolis temple courtyard, mausoleums, skeletal trees, spectral mist and gravestones confined to edges
text: Placement points regrow 20% faster. Heroes receive 15% less healing.

name: Autumn Sanctuary
setting: autumn temple courtyard in ancient woodland, red and orange maple canopy, fallen leaves, harvest stone statues at edges
palette: muted ochre, russet, moss, warm stone
text: Placement points regrow 15% faster. Road heroes charge their ultimates 15% faster.

name: Celestial Observatory
setting: astral observatory temple courtyard floating among stars, antique gold armillary mechanisms and celestial columns at perimeter
palette: midnight blue, pale gold, subdued starlight
text: Heroes charge ultimates 20% faster on odd waves and attack 10% faster on even waves.

name: Clockwork Citadel
setting: ancient clockwork temple courtyard, brass gears, steam vents, mechanical pillars and bronze conduits only at perimeter
palette: dark iron, tarnished brass, restrained turquoise
text: Heroes attack 15% faster. Enemies move 10% faster.
